title: Bugun – Bishkek mamlekettik universityinin negizdelgenine 46 years old!

blocks.text: Bul өzgөchoө kүndү belgilөө maksatynda universityte mayramdyk ish-chara өtup, student tarabynan chakan concert program tartuulandy. Ish-charany rector Mirlan Dyldaev kuttuktoo sozu menen achyp, bardyk okutuuchulardy, studentterdi zhana kyzmatkerlerdi universitytin maarakesi menen kuttuktady.

Universitytin onүgүshүnө, bilim beruү tarmagyna koshkon zor salymy zhana kөp zhyldyk үzүrluү emgegi үchүn bir katar okutuuchular Kusein Karasaev atyndagy tosh belgisi zhana Bishkek mamlekettik universityinin tosh belgisi menen syylanyshty.
Oshondoy ele okuu zhaidyn koomduk zhana madaniy turmushuna aktivdu katyshkan, bilim beru processinde өzgөchөlonongon okutuuchular menen studentterge Ardak gramtalar tapshyryldy.

Bul kun – ar biribiz үchүn syimyktuu kun. Bilim beruүnүn biyiktigin kөzөgөn, bilimge sugarylgan kelechek muundardy tarbiyalap zhatkan universityibizge osүp-onүguү, iygilik zhana chong zhetishkendikterdi kaalaibyz!
